$comment: Policy for unattended runs ONLY. Launch with: claude --setting-sources local --settings ~/dotfiles/claude/.claude/settings.unattended.json  (VERIFIED 2026-07-25). Why 'local' and not 'user' or 'managed': --setting-sources accepts only user|project|local. 'project' pulls the repo's 45 denies and its git/MCP deny hooks; 'user' pulls the global deny on git commit/push, and a deny always beats a higher-precedence allow — both were tested and both refuse the loop. The repo's .claude/settings.local.json has an empty deny array and defines no hooks, so it is the only near-empty base available. There is no `ask` array by design: in an unattended run an ask is a hang, so every rule is allow or deny.

sandbox.$excludedComment: git is excluded because the sandbox proxy allowlists by hostname over HTTP(S) and cannot carry SSH: a sandboxed push to git@github.com fails with 'nc: authentication method negotiation failed' (verified 2026-07-25). gh is excluded because Go-based CLIs fail TLS verification under Seatbelt. The three workflow wrappers are excluded because Seatbelt applies to the whole process tree: deploy-watch spawns gh, wait-for-push spawns git ls-remote, and cloud-fix-dispatch spawns both plus `claude --cloud` (which needs claude.ai, deliberately NOT added to allowedDomains — excluding the one wrapper is narrower than opening a domain to every command). Bare and starred forms are both listed because these take no-argument invocations. Nothing loses protection: git is governed semantically by unattended-git-guard.sh plus the deny patterns above, which is stronger than the sandbox for this purpose.

$hooksComment: Both entries invoke via `bash '<path>'` rather than executing the file directly, so they do not depend on an exec bit that the editing tool cannot set. The Stop entry was MISSING until 2026-07-26 — the gate script existed, was tested 11/11, and was documented as 'wired from settings.unattended.json', but nothing registered it, so it never ran. Do not remove it; without it the loop can end on a false pass.
$pluginComment: REQUIRED, not optional. Playwright is a plugin enabled via enabledPlugins in user-scope settings, and this profile deliberately omits the user scope — so without re-declaring it here the browser tools vanish and the entire local verification phase has nothing to drive. Verified missing before this was added (2026-07-25).
